name: Coffee + breakfast bars (no cooking)
equipment: burner + kettle or percolator for coffee
notes: No cooking. Leftover fruit from earlier meals goes out here instead of buying more.
Choose nut-free bars without gelatin (check labels) while allergy status is unknown.
prep: T-30: Start coffee (percolator or pour-over, ~0.5 oz grounds per 12 oz cup).
T-10: Set out bars, leftover fruit, cups, creamer, sugar.
